settings.guideHtml:
Overview (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Start page with search, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news. (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • All local: data stays in your browser (localStorage). (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Shortcuts (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • / : focus search (also via palette) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Enter in search: start search (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • ESC: close modals (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Palette: quick actions for widgets, theme, background, data, favorites (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets search & clock (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Search & Autocomplete (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Bangs: (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!g (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!ddg (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!bing (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!yt (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!wiki (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)!maps
  • Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings; (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.){q} as placeholder (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts search (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Tiles (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Drag & drop to sort, click to open (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • + Tile: add a new favorite (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Reset: restore default favorites (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Widgets & Layout (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Visibility per widget (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Custom colors for clock/search; reset restores style defaults (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Widget colors & "Tint widgets" set the accent per card (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Background (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/theme/interval) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Accent color is extracted from the active background (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
Data (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Export/Import as JSON (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
  • Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo) (Context: this label is intentionally explicit.)
